'''Sithlord119 Power of The Dark Side 2 Kill them Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sithlord119]]
* '''Published:''' 6 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-D-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Naboo Theed Palace Generator Core PowerofT.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Slightly modified version of my other deck with a few extras.

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

The strategy is still force drain however now you can epic duel Luke and/or Obi and duel loads of Jedi with Maul use sidious to place em out of

play.
